name: Train!
author: Davidian1024
description: Snake on rails: hook each new train car onto the end of your train without crashing into the cars or yourself. Watch the demo to see how it's done.

descriptions.en: Snake on rails: hook each new train car onto the end of your train without crashing into the cars or yourself. Watch the demo to see how it's done.
descriptions.it: Uno Snake su rotaie: aggancia ogni nuovo vagone in coda al tuo treno senza schiantarti contro i vagoni o contro te stesso. Guarda la demo per capire come si fa.
